title: Microsoft Forms: sensitivity labels on forms and generated Excel files
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned Forms labeling feature from existing Forms controls. The published paths and commands are supported, and searches found no Forms-specific labeling switch or rollout documentation. Licensing needs two clarifications: name the general Forms entitlement and acknowledge qualifications and conflicting wording in the Purview service description.
